text:
harper: Big shoutout to @nina and @omar for the all-hands setup help this morning. AV and chairs were perfect and the iced coffee situation was a lifesaver. :coffee: :clap:

nina: thanks! omar rescued the broken grinder at 7:05am with duct tape and a prayer. truly heroic. :mechanical_arm: :laughing:

omar: not duct tape, alpine zip-ties. details matter. also shoutout to @tal for springing to reorder the single-origin beans when stock hit zero. 

tal: got the beans on subscribe-and-save; ETA 2 days. booking note: if anyone needs a standing order for team events, fill this short form -> https://intranet.redwood/office/coffee-order :memo:

liza: facilities-bot ping: AC was bumped to 68F in the common area for demo week. thanks to the team for flagging earlier temps. :thermometer:

facilities-bot: Maintenance log: coffee-grinder replaced (GR-223) by omar at 2025-09-12T07:07Z. AC setpoint changed by liza. Next preventative check scheduled 2025-10-01.

harper: extra appreciation for @nina who stayed after to help Jane from Sales rehearse deck transitions. shear kindness. :sparkles:

nina: Jane did great! tiny tip for presenters: ctrl+shift+F toggles presenter view in the web slides. saves hunting for the next click. :sun_with_face:

omar: leaving a small stash of cinnamon chips in the kitchen for the late shift. first-come. :bagel:

tal: adding everybody to the kudos whiteboard. this one reads: "Coffee, chairs, and calm hands = saved demo vibes" :trophy:

liza: also want to call out @harper for coordinating volunteers and for the nifty labeled cable bag 90.00 that kept everything tidy. :label: :raised_hands:

harper: team effort all the way. thanks folks. tiny tradition: whoever saves the day gets bragging rights on the fridge magnet for a week. noms for tomorrow's snack: who votes for churros? :question:

nina: churros yes. :raised_hands:

omar: churros or donuts i will not discriminate. :smile:
file_note: kudos thread for facilities and cross-team help during demo week
